# cycle_vpn_users (Data Source)

Lists custom VPN users on an environment's VPN service. Passwords are write-only on create and are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_vpn_users" "api" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
}

output "vpn_usernames" {
  value = [for user in data.cycle_vpn_users.api.users : user.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment whose VPN users should be listed.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The VPN users configured on the environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the VPN user.
- `last_login` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last time this user logged into the VPN, if any.
- `username` (String) The VPN login username.
